concept_options.title: What If You Saw Who Uses AI to Text You?
concept_options.why_this_works: The topic title (f-see-who-uses-ai-to-text, 77/100); the writer's pick; pairs with thumbnail a (EVEN HER?)
concept_options.visual_approach: Your birthday, a dark kitchen before six, the lamp on: you large at the left, head 37% of the frame, holding your phone up at chest height and looking down at it, the instant before you understand; on the screen four long warm bubbles (your best friend's pink first) each carry a crimson dot, and one short grey-blue bubble at the bottom (your father's three words) has none; behind you on the table a small cake, its one candle just blown out, smoke curling up. Three candidates a, b, c differ only in the tag (EVEN HER?, A MACHINE DID., ALL OF THEM?); drawn in code, brand/thumbs/texts. The film stages this frame at 0:24
concept_options.hook: Your birthday, before six: you blow out the candle, and in the smoke a small red dot ticks on beside every message a machine wrote. The paragraph from your best friend that made you cry: dot. At the bottom, three words from your father on a cargo ship, with a typo: no dot.
